metadata.model: CLI default with user configuration ignored; exact underlying model not recorded
blockers: No protected holdout, repeated performance benchmark, or cross-host verification.
Development comparison uses one run per case and arm. Grading context was separate and arm-masked, with shared model-family and output-style limitations.

protocol.method: Fresh ephemeral read-only sessions; no tool calls; same fixture and base prompt per pair; treatment supplied the instruction and reference explicitly. Baseline had no access to either or to treatment output.
protocol.grading: A separate grader received unlabeled responses and the frozen expectations; format could reveal an arm. Integrator reconciled results and tool traces.

notes: Initial equal-score fixture did not state what the baseline excluded. The skill safely withheld a comparison, so that expectation failed. The ambiguity was fixed in the equal and higher score fixtures; reruns used unchanged skill and reference bytes. Unchanged cases retain their initial runs.
The pilot comparison is limited to these fixtures and does not establish efficacy, production readiness, or host discovery.
